caption:
🍝 Roasted tomato pasta recipe 🍝 

Ingredients
-2 large tomatoes 
-1 large onion
-2 red carrots
-1 green capsicum
-20+ cloves of garlic ( im crazy about garlic sorry) 
-2 tsp olive oil
-1 tsp salt
-1 tsp black pepper crushed
-red chilli flakes, as per your preference
-oregano, one sachet 
-1 packet mushroom ( 200 grams)
-100 grams pasta 
-any vegetables / protein /meat etc also can be added in.  #healthymeals #healthyrecipe #healthypasta #under1k #easymeals #roastedtomatopasta
